L. JELINIĆ · ZAGREB · 2024 DOLLY · FISHER 10

A KEY GRIP'S FILMOGRAPHY, BUILT ONE SETUP AT A TIME.

Luka Jelinić has worked as a key grip out of Zagreb for over a decade — building rigs for feature films, high-end episodic television, and commercial productions across Europe. The credit list reads like a small festival: Janusz Kaminski, Vanja Černjul, Jacques Jouffert, Steve Lawes, Mott Hupfel, Erol Zubčević, Thomas Dirnhofer, Anna Katharina Buhler.

The work spans HBO and Netflix series, Amazon originals, theatrical features, and commercial campaigns — BMW, Audi, Mercedes, Formula-E, Coca-Cola, McDonald's, Tanqueray, and most premium brands you'd expect to see at a film festival or on a television break.

"It's mechanical, it's mathematical, and at the end of the day it's about putting the camera exactly where the DOP imagined it — every single take."

He runs his own crew, owns and maintains the core rigging gear, and operates the technocrane, Russian arm, and car-rigging packages personally. Available worldwide as a key grip, daily rate, or on second-unit.
